name: init_pwm1_defaults
notes: PWMCON1/IOCON1/FCLCON1/TRGCON1, PHASE1=0x19D5, PDC1=0

notes: calls filter and PWM init; clears control flags; period ref=0x6E20

notes: clears duty/PDC1 and PWM-active flags; sets stopped/change status

notes: called by housekeeping before envelope update; likely IIR helper around C28

notes: run-request/input-valid gating and LATB bit3 output

notes: start/stop gate, relay/LED status, inhibit flags

notes: zero-cross/period average, setpoint filters, CMPDAC update

name: active_pwm_control

name: comparator1_isr
notes: clears IFS1 bit2

name: send_status_frame
notes: UART status frame: 0xEA + status + checksum

name: host_write_handler
notes: writes host command window at 0xBC8+addr, handles cmd 0x20/0x28

name: uart_rx_isr
notes: UART protocol state machine: start 0xEA, ACK 0x18, checksum

name: init_uart
notes: PPS mapping, U1BRG=0x1A, flags defaults

name: adc_pair0_isr
notes: reads ADCBUF0/1 delta, moving average, line counter

name: adc_pair1_isr
notes: reads ADCBUF2/3, updates line estimate, computes PDC1/TRIG1

name: main
notes: initializes peripherals and runs state machine loop

name: wait_ticks
notes: busy wait against Timer1-maintained C64 counter

name: timer1_isr
notes: timebase, debounce, state/ramp counters, comparator reenabling

name: math_housekeeping
notes: 32-bit rolling RMS/energy math

name: adc_pair2_isr
notes: reads ADCBUF4/5, rolling square/integral values

name: init_clock
notes: PLL/FRC switch and auxiliary clock enable

name: init_comparator1
notes: CMPCON1/CMPDAC1=0x3FF, interrupt enable

name: init_gpio
notes: LATB=0, TRISB=0xA6D3, RA3/RA4 outputs

name: init_timer1
notes: PR1=0x3415, T1 interrupt enable, T1ON

name: init_adc
notes: ADPCFG=0, ADCPC0/1 triggers, ADC interrupts

notes: reads ADCBUF6, current-limit/filter coefficient changes
